sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们专门为你制作了《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们两人才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: Oh, you're really bringing it for classy Christmas part two.
sentences.zh: 噢，你为了“高雅圣诞”第二部真是拼了。

sentences.en: Angela is wearing her Christmas sweatshirt.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉穿着她的圣诞运动衫。
这是我的圣诞糖针运动衫。

sentences.en: Which is available for purchase over at officeladies.com, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我想这件衣服可以在 officeladies.com 上买到。

sentences.en: I love to dress for theme.

sentences.zh: 好了，今天是第七季第十二集。

sentences.en: It was written by Mindy Kaling, directed by Rainn Wilson.
sentences.zh: 由敏迪·卡灵编剧，雷恩·威尔森执导。

sentences.en: It is Part 2 of what we started last week.
sentences.zh: 这是我们上周开始的那一集的第二部分。

sentences.en: Since this episode is a continuation, I thought everyone might appreciate a little update on my legs.
sentences.zh: 既然这一集是续集，我想大家可能想了解一下我腿部的最新情况。

sentences.en: Oh, I thought you were going to update us on where we were at in the episode, but no.
sentences.zh: 噢，我以为你要更新我们这一集的进度，结果不是。

sentences.en: But first, don't you want to know about my legs, if they're shaved or not?
sentences.zh: 但首先，你不想知道我的腿刮没刮毛吗？

sentences.en: Did I get a razor in the mail like you suggested?
sentences.zh: 我有没有像你建议的那样收到邮寄来的剃须刀？

sentences.en: Can I get a touch test?
sentences.zh: 我可以摸一下测试一下吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, you can see it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，你可以直接看。
看看那双闪亮的大长腿。

sentences.en: Just in time for fall weather.
Just in time for short skirts.
sentences.zh: 正好赶上穿短裙的时候。

sentences.en: Second update, I think we're going to need to make sure that Cassie is still working on the clacky balls.
sentences.zh: 第二个更新，我想我们需要确认一下卡西是否还在处理那些撞击球。

sentences.en: The clacky balls that a toddler destroyed.
sentences.zh: 那些被蹒跚学步的孩子毁掉的撞击球。

sentences.en: The setup she has in here with the lamp, and it's the most focused I've ever seen her.
sentences.zh: 她在这里摆弄灯具的样子，是我见过她最专注的时候。

sentences.en: Well, Cassie, if you untangle the balls, you need to break in immediately to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，卡西，如果你解开了那些球，你需要立刻打断我们的播客。

sentences.en: We want to know right away.
Now that we got that out of the way, here's your summary.
sentences.zh: 既然已经处理完了，这是你们的摘要。

sentences.en: Remember Michael forced Pam to redo the Christmas party for Holly's return?
sentences.zh: 还记得迈克尔强迫帕姆为了霍莉的回归重办圣诞派对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, he wanted a classy Christmas.
sentences.zh: 是的，他想要一个高雅的圣诞节。

sentences.en: But he learned that Holly is still dating AJ.
sentences.zh: 但他得知霍莉还在和AJ约会。

sentences.en: Also, Jim and Dwight got in an epic snowball fight.
sentences.zh: 还有，吉姆和德怀特进行了一场史诗般的打雪仗。

sentences.en: Well, that's not going to quit.
Daryl brought his daughter Jada to the Christmas party, and he's struggling to keep her entertained.
sentences.zh: 达里尔带他女儿杰达参加了圣诞派对，但他正努力让她玩得开心。

sentences.en: In this episode, Angela's boyfriend, the senator, is going to show up at the party.
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，安吉拉的男友，那位参议员，会出现在派对上。
她对此感到非常自鸣得意。

sentences.en: Except Oscar's pretty sure he's gay.
sentences.zh: 除了奥斯卡很确定他是同性恋。

sentences.en: And then AJ is going to arrive to surprise Holly.
sentences.zh: 然后AJ会赶来给霍莉一个惊喜。

sentences.en: And you thought there wouldn't be any drama at the Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 你还以为圣诞派对上不会有任何戏剧性事件呢。

sentences.en: Well, there wouldn't have been any drama at the first Christmas party.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果是在第一次圣诞派对上，本来是不会有任何戏剧性事件的。

sentences.en: So, fast fact number one, we had a fan mail flurry.
sentences.zh: 那么，第一个快讯，我们收到了一阵粉丝来信热潮。

sentences.en: It was all about that amazing comic book that Pam makes for Jim.
sentences.zh: 全都是关于帕姆为吉姆制作的那本神奇漫画书的。

sentences.en: You know the one, The Adventures of Jimmy Halpert.
sentences.zh: 你知道那本，吉米·哈珀特历险记。

sentences.en: In last week's episode, she showed it to Ryan, who didn't have a lot of nice things to say about it.
sentences.zh: 在上周的那一集里，她把它给瑞安看了，但他没说几句好话。

sentences.en: This episode, she shows it to Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 这一集，她把它给菲利斯看了。

sentences.en: I titled that scene Phyllis Snark.
sentences.zh: 我把那一幕命名为菲利斯的讽刺。

sentences.en: But then she finally gives it to Jim.
sentences.zh: 但后来她终于把它给了吉姆。

sentences.en: The fan mail flurry was all about who created this comic book.
sentences.zh: 粉丝来信热潮全都是关于这本漫画书是谁创作的。

sentences.en: Some people wanted to know, did I draw it?
sentences.zh: 有些人想知道，是我画的吗？

sentences.en: They had heard that I did used to do comic book art.
sentences.zh: 他们听说我以前确实画过漫画。

sentences.en: I have a little doodle you gave me.
sentences.zh: 我留着你给我的一个小涂鸦。

sentences.en: I saved all those years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是多年前我保存下来的。

sentences.en: You drew it on the set.
I got really into autobiographical comics for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间我非常沉迷于自传体漫画。

sentences.en: Joe Matt was one of my favorites.
sentences.zh: 乔·马特是我最喜欢的漫画家之一。

sentences.en: And then I started kind of drawing out basically almost like diary entries.
sentences.zh: 然后我就开始画一些基本上像是日记条目的东西。

sentences.en: So I had a little myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我自己也画了一点。
我曾有过一个小小的你。

sentences.en: For this comic book, I will say I did not draw this.
sentences.zh: 关于这本漫画书，我要声明我没画过。

sentences.en: You know, you see glimpses of it in the episode.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在剧集里能瞥见一些片段。

sentences.en: To find someone to do this comic book, Phil Shea reached out to a comic book shop called
sentences.zh: 为了找到能画这本漫画书的人，菲尔·谢伊联系了一家叫

sentences.en: DJ's Universal Comics, and a woman there named Kat suggested that he reach out to a local
sentences.zh: DJ's Universal Comics的漫画店，店里一位叫凯特的女士建议他联系当地一位

sentences.en: comic book artist named Tone Rodriguez.
sentences.zh: 叫托恩·罗德里格斯的漫画家。

sentences.en: Tone had been working on The Simpsons comics for several years, and she thought he might be
sentences.zh: 托恩已经画了好几年的《辛普森一家》漫画，她觉得他可能是一个

sentences.en: And he told us his whole story.
sentences.zh: 他向我们讲述了他的整个故事。

sentences.en: It is amazing, and I cannot wait to share.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了，我迫不及待想分享出来。

sentences.en: So Tone said, one day, Phil just called him out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 托恩说，有一天，菲尔突然给他打了电话。

sentences.en: And Phil said, I need a comic book drawn up.
sentences.zh: 菲尔说，我需要画一本漫画书。

sentences.en: And Tone said, well, when do you need it by?
sentences.zh: 托恩问，那你什么时候要？

sentences.en: And Tone didn't think he could do it.
He sort of said, I can't turn it around that quickly.
sentences.zh: 他当时说，我没法那么快赶出来。

sentences.en: But Phil said, why don't you come down to set so I can better explain what we need?
sentences.zh: 但菲尔说，你为什么不来片场，让我更好地解释我们需要什么？

sentences.en: Phil didn't tell him what show it was.
sentences.zh: 菲尔没告诉他这是什么剧。

sentences.en: He knew he was drawing something for a TV show, but he didn't know what won.
sentences.zh: 他只知道自己在为一部电视剧画东西，但不知道是哪部。

sentences.en: He said he got to the studio.
It was a weird part of town.
He said he just walked past the gate, and he started basically just wandering around.
sentences.zh: 他说他直接走过了大门，开始在那儿漫无目的地闲逛。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was just asking, does anyone know someone named Phil?
sentences.zh: 是啊，他就在那儿问，有人认识叫菲尔的人吗？

sentences.en: Finally, he made it to Phil's prop trailer, where he got introduced to Paul Lieberstein.
sentences.zh: 最后，他找到了菲尔的道具拖车，在那里被介绍给了保罗·里伯斯坦。

sentences.en: They started to explain what we needed.
sentences.zh: 他们开始解释我们需要什么。

sentences.en: But then they said, you know what?
sentences.zh: 但随后他们说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So we should check with her.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该去问问她。

sentences.en: Tone said by this point, he realized the show was called The Office, but he'd never seen it.
sentences.zh: 托恩说到了这一步，他意识到这部剧叫《办公室》，但他从没看过。

sentences.en: He said he doesn't watch much TV because if he starts watching something, it really distracts him from his art.
sentences.zh: 他说他不怎么看电视，因为如果他开始看什么东西，会非常影响他创作艺术。

sentences.en: He has to focus, and so he doesn't get into television shows.
sentences.zh: 他必须保持专注，所以他不怎么看电视剧。

sentences.en: So they walk him on set to meet Mindy, and here's what he said.
sentences.zh: 于是他们带他去片场见敏迪，他是这么说的。

sentences.en: He said, I'll be 100% honest here.
sentences.zh: 他说，我百分之百诚实地说。

sentences.en: We were on set waiting for Mindy to give us a heads up on what she wanted for the comic, and when she walked up to the three of us,
sentences.zh: 我们在片场等着敏迪给我们指示她想要什么样的漫画，当她向我们三个走过来时，

sentences.en: I swear I have no recollection of what she had to say.
sentences.zh: 我发誓我完全不记得她说了些什么。

sentences.en: She walked up to us, and it was like the scene in Wayne's World where Garth sees the woman in the donut shop.
sentences.zh: 她朝我们走过来，那场景就像《韦恩的世界》里加斯在甜甜圈店看到那个女人的那一幕。

sentences.en: The light radiating from behind her, and you're hearing Dream Weaver by Gary Wright.
sentences.zh: 她身后散发着光芒，耳边响起了加里·赖特的《织梦者》。

sentences.en: She had me absolutely speechless, and I have no idea what she might have said.
sentences.zh: 她让我彻底说不出话来，我根本不知道她可能说了什么。

sentences.en: I had never seen the show.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没看过那部剧。

sentences.en: Maybe if I had, I would not have been as surprised by her, but I was.
sentences.zh: 也许如果我看过，就不会对她那么惊讶了，但我确实被惊艳到了。

sentences.en: So he says she explained everything she needed, and at the end of the encounter, she said, did you get that?
sentences.zh: 所以他说她解释了所有需要说明的事，在谈话结束时，她问他，你听懂了吗？

sentences.en: And she turned and walked away, and at that point, he said, Phil and Paul turned to him and said, did you get that?
sentences.zh: 然后她转身走开了，就在那时，他说，菲尔和保罗转向他问，你听懂了吗？

sentences.en: And he said, I have no idea what she said.
sentences.zh: 他说，我根本不知道她说了什么。

sentences.en: And he said, they must have seen the effect she had on idiots like me before.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们肯定以前就见过她对像我这样的傻瓜产生的影响。

sentences.en: Because at this point, they both said, yeah, we know.
sentences.zh: 因为在那一刻，他们俩都说，是啊，我们知道。

sentences.en: We wrote it down for you.
sentences.zh: 我们已经帮你记下来了。

sentences.en: And he said, that's a 100% true story.
sentences.zh: 他说，那是一个百分之百真实的故事。

sentences.en: And then he said, my wife hates that story, huh?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我妻子讨厌这个故事，是吧？

sentences.en: Mindy is someone, when you meet her, she just, she's a captivating person.
sentences.zh: 明迪就是那种人，当你见到她时，她就是……她是一个非常迷人的人。

sentences.en: I mean, she's beautiful, and she has kind of an aura, and she's confident.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她很漂亮，而且有一种光环，她很自信。

sentences.en: So I asked Tone, how many pages did you illustrate?
sentences.zh: 所以我问托恩，你画了多少页？

sentences.en: And he said that he drew the cover and two interior pages.
sentences.zh: 他说他画了封面和两页内页。

sentences.en: He said a full comic book is usually 22 pages.
sentences.zh: 他说一本完整的漫画书通常有22页。

sentences.en: So that's why he panicked when Phil said they needed it in a few days.
sentences.zh: 所以当菲尔说他们几天内就需要它时，他才会那么慌张。

sentences.en: But he said after they explained what Mindy wanted, they said just two pages would be fine,
sentences.zh: 但他说是的，在他们解释了明迪想要什么之后，他们说只要两页就行了，

sentences.en: and they would just duplicate them a couple times to make it look like a full comic book.
sentences.zh: 他们会把这两页复制几次，让它看起来像一本完整的漫画书。

sentences.en: Tone said everything in the comic book is hand-drawn, including the logo on the front.
sentences.zh: 托恩说漫画书里的一切都是手绘的，包括封面的标志。

sentences.en: And he said all of the lettering inside was done by his buddy, Tony Fleece.
sentences.zh: 他说里面的所有文字都是他哥们托尼·弗利斯写的。

sentences.en: And he said people just, you didn't do it digitally back then.
sentences.zh: 他说人们只是……那时候还没法用数字技术做这些。

sentences.en: And he said that the script inside, all the words, he took directly from the note that Phil and Paul had handed him after his meeting with Mindy.
sentences.zh: 他说里面的脚本，所有的文字，都是他直接从菲尔和保罗在他与明迪会面后递给他的那张纸条上抄下来的。

sentences.en: You guys, a few years ago, I was at a comic convention in Philadelphia, and I saw the comic book, The Adventures of Jimmy Halpert.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，几年前，我在费城参加一个漫画展，我看到了那本漫画书，《吉米·哈尔珀特历险记》。

sentences.en: I was so excited by it that the vendor gave me two.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了，摊主给了我两本。

sentences.en: So Jenna has one, and I have one.
sentences.zh: 所以珍娜有一个，我也有一个。

sentences.en: And I don't know if they're originals.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它们是不是原版。

sentences.en: Tone said people come up to him all the time and tell him that they purchased one of the original props.
sentences.zh: 托恩说经常有人跑来告诉他，说他们买到了其中一个原版道具。

sentences.en: And he said, I hate to disappoint people, but there were only eight of them that were made for the show.
sentences.zh: 他说，我很不想让大家失望，但剧组当时一共只制作了八个。

sentences.en: He gave two to one of his friends in Stockton, California, one to a fan in Bakersfield.
sentences.zh: 他给了加州斯托克顿的一个朋友两个，还给贝克斯菲尔德的一个粉丝送了一个。

sentences.en: He said there's maybe three original copies out there, but he does make replicas of the book, and he makes them available to different vendors at shows.
sentences.zh: 他说市面上可能只有三个原版，但他确实会制作这本书的复制品，并提供给展会上的不同商家。

sentences.en: We'll have to share that in stories.
sentences.zh: 我们得在故事里分享一下。

sentences.en: Yes, he says there's an email you can use to contact him about getting one.
sentences.zh: 是的，他说有一个电子邮箱可以联系他购买。

sentences.en: We can put that in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把它写在节目简介里。

sentences.en: He said they're limited, but you should contact Jacob at that email address.
sentences.zh: 他说数量有限，但你可以通过那个邮箱地址联系雅各布。

sentences.en: But we'll put it in show notes.
sentences.zh: 不过我们还是会把它写在节目简介里。

sentences.en: But thank you, Tone, so much.
I always love hearing stories like that.
sentences.zh: 我总是很喜欢听这样的故事。

sentences.en: Well, fast fact number two comes to us from Stose B.
sentences.zh: 好了，第二个速递事实来自华盛顿特区的斯托斯·B。

sentences.en: This is a piece of fan mail that just absolutely warmed my heart, and it's episode-specific, and I can't wait to share it.
sentences.zh: 这是一封让我倍感温暖的粉丝来信，而且它和特定剧集有关，我迫不及待想分享给大家。

sentences.en: Stose said, in all capitals, my daughter was born to this episode of The Office.
sentences.zh: 斯托斯用全大写字母写道：我的女儿是在这一集《办公室》的陪伴下出生的。

sentences.en: I've been waiting to tell this story since she was born on Christmas Eve in 2019.
sentences.zh: 自从她2019年平安夜出生以来，我就一直等着讲这个故事。

sentences.en: I went into labor with my first daughter on December 23rd, and as soon as Midnight on Christmas Eve hit, Comedy Central started playing The Office Christmas episodes on repeat.
sentences.zh: 我是在12月23日开始阵痛的，平安夜午夜一过，喜剧中心频道就开始循环播放《办公室》的圣诞特辑。

sentences.en: I kept them on all day, and when the time came to push around 4 p.m., the nurses tried to turn the TV off.
sentences.zh: 我整天都开着电视，当下午4点左右到了分娩时刻，护士想把电视关掉。

sentences.en: But I kept it on, using the episodes to keep me calm and focused for the next two hours.
sentences.zh: 但我坚持没让关，在接下来的两个小时里，我靠着这些剧集保持冷静和专注。

sentences.en: And the last thing I remember listening to is Oscar and Ryan's bit about bartending.
sentences.zh: 我记得最后听到的内容是奥斯卡和瑞安关于调酒的桥段。

sentences.en: It was truly the best way to bring my daughter into the world.
sentences.zh: 这真的是迎接我女儿来到这个世界最好的方式。
噢，我太喜欢这个故事了。

sentences.en: I love that she was like, no, you will not turn that off.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢她那种“不，你不能关掉它”的态度。

sentences.en: And now, fast fact number three, Angela, is all you.
sentences.zh: 现在，第三个速递事实，安吉拉，全看你的了。

sentences.en: You know it's my favorite thing when you say, can I have a fast fact?
sentences.zh: 你知道我最喜欢你问我“我可以分享一个速递事实吗？”的时候了。

sentences.en: Yes, and it actually pairs very nicely with Stos' story.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且它和斯托斯的故事非常契合。

sentences.en: Well, my fast fact three is all about Ryan and his drink order of an F-Train to Brooklyn extra bitters.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的第三个速递事实是关于瑞安点的酒——“布鲁克林F线列车，多加苦精”。

sentences.en: So you know from that Office Tally interview that was great, where Mindy said she made it up.
sentences.zh: 所以你从那次很棒的《办公室》统计采访中知道，明迪说那是她编出来的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a made-up drink.
sentences.zh: 没错，那是一款虚构的饮品。

sentences.en: But she said BJ pitched the line with extra bitters.
sentences.zh: 但她说BJ在推销这款酒时加了额外的苦精。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it got me curious if any component of this drink exists in the world, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我就很好奇，这款酒里的任何成分在现实中存在吗？

sentences.en: First thing, the F-Train is real.
sentences.zh: 首先，F线地铁是真实存在的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, it goes to Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，它是去布鲁克林的。

sentences.en: It operates from 179th Street in Jamaica, Queens, all the way to Stilwell Avenue in Coney Island, Brooklyn.

吉姆开始攻击那些雪人。

sentences.en: And we had a final fan question from Grace B.
sentences.zh: 我们还收到了来自阿肯色州克林顿市的格蕾丝·B发来的最后一个粉丝提问。

sentences.en: How did Jim and Pam get out of the parking lot?
sentences.zh: 吉姆和帕姆是怎么离开停车场的？

sentences.en: They would have had to driven through it.
sentences.zh: 他们本得开车撞过去才行。

sentences.en: Grace said, this keeps me up at night.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝说，这个问题让她彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: Grace, once I read your question and watched the scene, now it's all I can think of.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝，我读了你的问题并重看了那一幕后，现在满脑子都是这个问题。

sentences.en: Well, that was classy Christmas, too, everyone.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那也是“优雅的圣诞节”，各位。

sentences.en: Next week, we're going to be back with Ultimatum.
sentences.zh: 下周我们将回归，讨论“最后通牒”那一集。

sentences.en: A big thank you to Josh Snyder for this amazing F Train to Brooklyn drink.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢乔什·斯奈德为我们调制了这款超棒的“F线去布鲁克林”饮品。

sentences.en: Thank you, Angela and Cade, for going to the CatCon and bringing us these lovely gifts.
sentences.zh: 谢谢安吉拉和凯德去参加猫咪大会并带回这些可爱的礼物。
还有玛莎·斯图尔特，谢谢你！

sentences.en: Thank you so much for designing a short-sleeve puffer jacket that you call a puffer tee.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你设计了一款短袖羽绒外套，你称之为羽绒T恤。

sentences.en: Yes, because it looks like a t-shirt, but it's a puffer.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为它看起来像T恤，但它是羽绒材质的。

sentences.en: But t-shirts don't have zippers down the front of them.
Which is why it's not a t-shirt.
We also would like to thank Randy Cordray.
sentences.zh: 我们还要感谢兰迪·科德雷。

sentences.en: Every week, he gives us the best behind-the-scenes details.
sentences.zh: 他每周都为我们提供最棒的幕后细节。

sentences.en: And of course, Tone Rodriguez, thank you so much for telling us about your comic book.
sentences.zh: 当然还有托恩·罗德里格斯，非常感谢你告诉我们关于你漫画书的事。

sentences.en: And to Cassie for undoing the clacky balls.
sentences.zh: 还要感谢卡西帮我们解开了那些咔哒响的球。

sentences.en: You guys have a great week.
sentences.zh: 祝大家度过愉快的一周。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.
Office Ladies is produced by Earwolf, Jenna Fisher, and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由Earwolf、珍娜·费舍和安吉拉·金赛制作。

sentences.en: Our show is executive produced by Cody Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目由科迪·费舍担任执行制片人。

sentences.en: Our sound engineer is Sam Kiefer.
sentences.zh: 我们的音效工程师是Sam Kiefer。

sentences.en: And our associate producer is Ainsley Bubico.
sentences.zh: 我们的助理制片人是Ainsley Bubico。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rubber Tree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是Creed Bratton创作的《Rubber Tree》。
